_note: 學習路徑內容第23批 #3／6：被動語態 by 片語與施事者省略（eng.t_mid.voice.by-agent，會考級／中階）。被動句用 by 片語點出動作者；當動作者不知道／明顯／不重要時省略 by 片語（省略時不留懸空的 by）；動作者是新資訊或重要時保留。誘答鎖『動作者誤用 with／用了 by 卻無動作者懸空／漏 be 動詞／漏 by／誤用進行主動』等唯一正解；避開 by vs with 工具爭議，只在工具明確用 with 的對比句用。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix vba_）。

units.title_zh: 被動語態：by 片語與施事者省略
units.can_do: 我能用 by 片語在被動句點出動作者，並判斷何時該省略 by 片語（動作者不知道／明顯／不重要）、何時該保留（動作者是重要或新資訊）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In the passive, the doer (agent) is shown with a 'by' phrase: 'The letter was written by my grandfather.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動句用 by 片語帶出動作者（The letter was written by my grandfather）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The 'by' phrase is usually left out when the doer is unknown, obvious or unimportant: 'My phone was stolen last night.' (we don't know who). A 'by' with no named doer after it is not used.
claims.verification_ref: 動作者不知道／明顯／不重要時省略 by 片語、不留懸空的 by（My phone was stolen last night）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: We keep the 'by' phrase when the doer is new or important information: 'The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.'
claims.verification_ref: 動作者是重要／新資訊時保留 by 片語（invented by Bell）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A passive needs a be-verb plus the past participle: 'America was discovered by Columbus.' ('discovered by' without 'was', or 'was discover', is wrong.)
claims.verification_ref: 被動＝be 動詞＋過去分詞（was discovered by Columbus）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: In the passive, we use a 'by' phrase to show the doer (the agent). The cake was made by my mom. 被動句用 by 片語點出動作者。
This song was written by a famous singer.　（這首歌是一位名歌手寫的。by 帶出動作者。）
When the doer is unknown, obvious or unimportant, we leave out the 'by' phrase. We do not keep a 'by' with nobody after it. The streets are cleaned every morning. 動作者不重要時省略 by 片語。
My wallet was stolen yesterday.　（我的錢包昨天被偷了。不知道是誰偷的，省略 by。）
We keep the 'by' phrase when the doer is important or new information. The homework was checked by the teacher. 動作者是重要資訊時保留 by 片語。
The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.　（電話是貝爾發明的。發明者很重要，保留 by。）

practice.stem: 選正確：The letter was written ____ my grandfather.（這封信是我爺爺寫的）

distractor_rationales.with: with 用在工具；施事者（動作者）用 by。
distractor_rationales.from: from 表來源方向，語意不對。
distractor_rationales.of: of 無法帶出被動句的動作者，語意不對。

practice.feedback: written by my grandfather：被動句用 by 帶出動作者。

practice.stem: 選正確：The classroom ____ every day; we never see who does it.（教室每天被打掃，省略動作者）

distractor_rationales.is cleaned by: by 後面要接動作者，這裡不知道是誰、應省略，不能讓 by 懸空。
distractor_rationales.cleans: 主詞 The classroom 是被打掃的，要用被動式，不用主動 cleans。
distractor_rationales.is cleaning: is cleaning 是進行式主動，語意變成『教室正在打掃別的東西』，不對。

practice.feedback: The classroom is cleaned every day：動作者不知道，省略 by，不留懸空的 by。

practice.stem: 選出正確的被動句（保留重要動作者）：
practice.answer: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
options: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
The Mona Lisa painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
The Mona Lisa was painted Leonardo da Vinci.
The Mona Lisa was paint by Leonardo da Vinci.

distractor_rationales.The Mona Lisa painted by Leonardo da Vin: 被動句要有 be 動詞 was，不能只用 painted。
distractor_rationales.The Mona Lisa was painted Leonardo da Vi: 動作者前面要加 by（painted by Leonardo da Vinci），不能漏掉。
distractor_rationales.The Mona Lisa was paint by Leonardo da V: 被動要用過去分詞 painted，不用原形 paint。

practice.feedback: was painted by Leonardo da Vinci：be 動詞＋過去分詞＋by 動作者（重要資訊保留）。

practice.stem: 選正確：The bread was cut ____ a sharp knife.（麵包是用一把利刀切的──工具）

distractor_rationales.by: by 帶出施事者（動作者）；a sharp knife 是被人使用的工具，工具用 with。
distractor_rationales.of: of 無法表示切麵包的工具，語意不對。
distractor_rationales.from: from 表來源方向，語意不對。

practice.feedback: cut with a sharp knife：工具用 with；動作者才用 by。

practice.stem: 選正確：「Who repaired your bike?」「It ____ my uncle.」（誰修好你的腳踏車？──我叔叔修的，動作者是問題的重點）

distractor_rationales.was repaired: 問的就是『誰』修的，動作者是重點，要保留 by my uncle，不能省略。
distractor_rationales.repaired by: 被動句要有 be 動詞 was，不能只用 repaired by。
distractor_rationales.was repairing: was repairing 是進行式主動，語意不對；這裡要被動。

practice.feedback: It was repaired by my uncle：動作者是重要新資訊，保留 by。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The homework was checked by the teacher this morning.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：was checked（be＋過去分詞）、by the teacher、this morning、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。by 片語略提動作者、句尾下收。

lines.text: This bridge was built by workers long ago.
lines.intonation: built by workers 連讀、ago 句尾下收

lines.text: The windows are cleaned every week.
lines.intonation: are cleaned 連讀、week 句尾下收
